original_value: A fictional desktop ambient display with soft reactive lighting, sunrise alarm functions, and an integrated digital clock for quiet rooms and creative workspaces. Designed as a home décor accessory rather than a storage device, it pairs a brushed polymer shell with customizable color scenes and low-power USB-C charging.
